propositions: Eight empty, uncommitted, untracked top-level ticket directories exist in the tracker with no CREATE event, flagged by fsck as MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH, resulting from processes interrupted mid-write during directory creation.

All eight directories pass five safety guards: empty, uncommitted, rebar exists returns exit 1, zero open file handles, and mtime older than 30 minutes, confirming they are safe debris to remove and not active writer state.

rebar tracker-maintenance --clean must execute an all-or-nothing removal of the foreign directory set only if the run-level gate holds: --status foreign list must equal the exact eight triaged ids before any write occurs.

After executing --clean with all guards and gate verified, fsck reports zero MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH findings, all eight directories are removed from the filesystem, and no committed ticket data is modified.
